description: This file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardWithQuickText' that extends 'AnySoftKeyboardMediaInsertion' and manages quick text functionalities within the keyboard app, including switching to quick text keyboard, handling quick text requests, and cleaning up the quick text UI.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardWithQuickText
classes.description: An abstract class extending 'AnySoftKeyboardMediaInsertion' that manages quick text features, including switching keyboards, handling quick text requests, and cleaning up UI components.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences and preference trackers related to quick text functionality.

methods.name: onQuickTextRequested
methods.description: Handles a quick text request, either outputting the current quick text key or switching to the quick text keyboard based on user settings.

methods.name: onQuickTextKeyboardRequested
methods.description: Handles a request to switch to the quick text keyboard or output the quick text key, depending on user preferences.

methods.name: outputCurrentQuickTextKey
methods.description: Outputs the quick text associated with a key, either using default text or an override string.

methods.name: onFinishInputView
methods.description: Cleans up the quick text keyboard when input view is finished.

methods.name: switchToQuickTextKeyboard
methods.description: Replaces the current input view with the quick text keyboard layout.

methods.name: cleanUpQuickTextKeyboard
methods.description: Removes the quick text layout and optionally restores the standard keyboard view.

methods.name: handleCloseRequest
methods.description: Handles the close request, ensuring quick text UI is cleaned up.
